propositions: Bug c8ed (incorrect outbound depends_on link direction) was not caught by tests because the link-sync test suite exercised only a single representative relation (blocks) instead of the full relation vocabulary.

The link-dedup test suite must be parametrized over all 6 relations (blocks, depends_on, relates_to, duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) with assertions on the correct (jira_type, swap) tuple for mapped relations and empty results for unmapped relations.

A REMOVE case is missing test coverage for the untested branch where a Jira issue carries an outward Blocks link whose local depends_on dependency was removed, requiring an emission of {action: remove, relation: depends_on}.
New test cases must assert per-relation ORIENTATION (swap flag and endpoint tuple ordering) to ensure that a re-drop of the swap fix would cause test failures.
